entries.title: Closing a task no longer makes the app pause on a long record
entries.body: Each time a task closed, the app reread every task you have ever had to tidy closed tasks' files, which held the window still for about half a second on a long record. It now reads only the tasks that closed since it last looked.
entries.noPicture: This removes a pause after a task closes; no view or control changes.
